status.en: 187 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 28% fewer than the week before, most of them in Moscow, Kyiv and Kharkiv.
status.nb: 187 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 28 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Moskva, Kyiv og Kharkiv.

summary.en: Russian forces continue drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, including an Oryol electronics plant and Moscow-area airports, while Ukrainian forces retaliate with strikes on the same airports, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for its military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and the conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Russiske styrker fortsetter drone‑ og missilangrep mot ukrainske sivile mål, inkludert et elektronikkverk i Oryol og flyplasser i Moskva-området, mens ukrainske styrker svarer med angrep på de samme flyplassene, et fabrikkanlegg i Tolyatti og en flyplass i Krasnodar Krai. I den okkuperte byen Oleshky har en lokal våpenhvile forhandlet av Melania Trump redusert kampene, og en egen våpenhvile ble avtalt for en annen by. Ukraina melder at hastighetsbegrensningene på Starlink er fjernet, og at stabil tilkobling er gjenopprettet for militæret. En hemmelig ukrainsk dyp-angrepsenhet utvider kampanjen sin, og konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
background.extractNb: Russlands invasjon av Ukraina 2022 begynte tidlig om morgenen 24. februar, da russiske styrker gjennomførte et stort angrep på Ukraina. Dette var en kraftig opptrapping av krigen i Ukraina, som har pågått siden 2014 og blant annet omfattet okkupasjon av Krym. Invasjonen har ført til titusenvis av døde på hver side, og ledet til Europas største flyktningkrise siden andre verdenskrig. Om lag 8 millioner ukrainere var internflyktninger i juni 2022, og over 8 millioner hadde flyktet fra landet i mai 2023.

posts.text:
⚡️️️️️️️Sanctioned Russian energy giant secretly funded US gas project, NYT reports.

The gas project was part of an energy deal discussed by U.S. peace envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner during their September visit to the Kremlin, sources told the New York Times.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️️️️️️️Massive Ukrainian drone attack hits shopping center in Russia's Belgorod Oblast, locals say. 

MegaGRINN is the largest shopping complex in Belgorod, covering over 163,000 square meters and housing more than 200 shops. The center was closed and empty of visitors during the overnight attack.

posts.text:

One of the injured victims is an 11-year-old girl. Five wounded individuals are being treated in the hospital, with two in serious condition and undergoing surgery.

posts.text:

Elon Musk said that Ukraine's military violated the terms of service for Starlink, adding that the "loophole" has now been closed.

Russian citizens and 44 businesses producing and supplying raw materials, equipment, and tools used in long-range weapons like Iskander, Kalibr, Kh-101, and Kinzhal missiles.
